summary: Full E2E test of the new Emergent-managed password reset flow (forgot-password → DB token → reset-password → login with new password). Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass. Frontend: all 6 UI assertions pass (new email-link button on /forgot-password, /reset-password happy path, missing-token banner, length validation, mismatch toast, invalid-token error, password toggle, back-to-login). Email proxy itself verified working (sent to delivered@resend.dev → message_id 01a110d8-...); the 422 'Undeliverable recipient' on admin@test.com is expected because that domain is unroutable — the task note explicitly accepts this and the DB side-effect (reset_token stored) still occurs. Admin credentials were restored to 153759 after testing.

minor.issue: Resend proxy returns 422 'Undeliverable recipient' for admin@test.com (expected, test-domain). Error is logged as '[SECURITY] Password reset email FAILED' but endpoint still returns the generic 200 success message and stores reset_token in DB — correct anti-enumeration behaviour.

critical_code_review_comments: forgot_password at auth.py:1347 and reset_password_request at auth.py:2072 are duplicate implementations of the same flow — consider consolidating into one route to avoid drift.

reset_password at auth.py:2106 accepts reset_token + new_password as QUERY parameters, which means they get written to access logs and browser history. Consider moving to JSON body for defense-in-depth (token is single-use + 1-hour expiry, so impact is limited).
ResetPassword.js:55 — frontend also sends new_password in URL query (matches backend signature). Same risk as above, OK to keep until backend switches to JSON body.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin@test.com user; reset_token field reused each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset flow is fully working E2E. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset_flow.py. The suite auto-restores admin PIN=153759 at teardown. Note the Emergent Resend proxy will 422 for *@test.com domains; use delivered@resend.dev or a real address to test actual delivery. Message_id returned on success proves the integration works.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All DB side-effects, token lifecycle (store → clear-on-use → cannot-reuse), server-side validation (404 invalid, 400 expired), and client-side validation (length, mismatch, missing token guard) behave correctly. Light pastel theme (#FFF9E6 cream background, #FFFFFF card, #D1FAE5 border, #14532D forest text) applied correctly on ResetPassword page.
